name: Subject and Message-ID filter
description: Exercises match_subject_step and match_message_id_step in sequence (AND semantics via @stop chaining, same pattern as sender_recipient_filter.json): subject must contain 'Purchase Order Confirmation' AND Message-ID must end in '@orders.partner-shipping.com>'. On match, saves every attachment under ./out/subject-msgid-filter/. Use with example-data/emails/po_confirmation_match.eml (matches both, attachment saved), po_confirmation_subject_mismatch.eml (subject fails first, match_message_id_step never runs, nothing saved), or po_confirmation_message_id_mismatch.eml (subject matches but the Message-ID domain doesn't, nothing saved).
